items.title: Multi-layer Indexer: Overlapping Selection and Attention in DeepSeek Sparse Attention
items.title_zh: 多层索引器：DeepSeek稀疏注意力中的重叠选择和注意力
items.description: Sparse attention cuts the cost of long-context inference by making the attention matrix sparse: each query attends only a subset of the sequence, chosen by a fixed pattern or, in recent production LLMs, learned per query. In DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), the attention of DeepSeek-V3.2 and the GLM-5 family, every layer is preceded by a lightning indexer that scores the whole cache and keeps the k=2048 highest-scoring tokens for the layer to attend. At long context this indexer scan, not the sparse attention it feeds, is where the decode time goes. But adjacent layers select nearly the same tokens, so a layer can attend the selection of the previous indexer layer instead of its own. This removes the dependency: each indexer then runs concurrently with the attention of its layer. The resulting Multi-layer Indexer (MLI) needs no retraining and no new weights. Its default realization changes no kernel, running inside SGLang's production decode graph; an optional fused decode kernel accelerates it further on DeepSeek-V3.2. MLI composes with IndexCache (the cross-layer reuse GLM-5.2 ships as IndexShare): IndexCache drops the indexer from some layers, and MLI hides the scan on the rest. We serve DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5 under IndexCache's protocol at retentions 1/2 to 1/32 (the fraction of layers that keep an indexer) and contexts 10K to 195K. At equal retention the composition decodes faster than IndexCache: up to 14.5% faster on DeepSeek-V3.2 and 9.8% on GLM-5 at 1/2, and 7.9% and 5.1% at 1/4, largest where IndexCache keeps the most indexers and growing with context. At retention 1/r it is faster still than IndexCache at 1/(2r) while keeping twice the fresh selections: at 128K it reaches 1.32x the unmodified model's decode throughput at 1/4, above IndexCache's 1.28x at 1/8. Its LongBench, RULER and LongBench v2 accuracy stays within a few percentage points of IndexCache's.
items.description_zh: 稀疏注意力通过使注意力矩阵稀疏来降低长上下文推理的成本：每个查询仅关注序列的一个子集，由固定模式选择，或者在最近的生产LLM中，每个查询都学习。在 DeepSeek 稀疏注意力 (DSA)、DeepSeek-V3.2 和 GLM-5 系列的注意力中，每一层之前都有一个闪电索引器，该索引器对整个缓存进行评分，并保留 k=2048 个最高得分令牌供该层参与。在长上下文中，解码时间花在索引器扫描上，而不是它所提供的稀疏注意力上。但相邻层选择几乎相同的标记，因此层可以参与前一个索引器层的选择，而不是自己的选择。这消除了依赖性：每个索引器然后与其层的注意力同时运行。由此产生的多层索引器 (MLI) 不需要重新训练，也不需要新的权重。它的默认实现不改变内核，在 SGLang 的生产解码图中运行；可选的融合解码内核可在 DeepSeek-V3.2 上进一步加速。 MLI 与 IndexCache 组合（跨层重用 GLM-5.2 作为 IndexShare 提供）：IndexCache 从某些层删除索引器，MLI 隐藏其余层的扫描。我们在 IndexCache 协议下提供 DeepSeek-V3.2 和 GLM-5，保留量为 1/2 到 1/32（保留索引器的层的分数），上下文为 10K 到 195K。在保留相同的情况下，该组合的解码速度比 IndexCache 更快：在 1/2 时，DeepSeek-V3.2 上快了 14.5%，在 GLM-5 上快了 9.8%，在 1/4 时分别快了 7.9% 和 5.1%，其中 IndexCache 保留了最多的索引器，并随着上下文而增长。在保留 1/r 时，它仍然比 IndexCache 在 1/(2r) 时更快，同时保留两倍的新鲜选择：在 128K 时，它达到未修改模型解码吞吐量的 1.32 倍（1/4 时），高于 IndexCache 1/8 时的 1.28 倍。它的 LongBench、RULER 和 LongBench v2 准确度与 IndexCache 的准确度相差几个百分点。
items.authors: Serdarcan Dilbaz, Arjun Krishna, Kiran Kamble, Daniel M. Bikel

items.title: Halley: A Predictive Control Plane for Optical AI Data Center Networks
items.title_zh: Halley：光学人工智能数据中心网络的预测控制平面
items.description: A frontier AI model is trained in an AI data center, on tens of thousands of accelerators joined by a dedicated network, and every training step ends with all of them exchanging data at once. Between racks, that network is optical, and each of its four layers, from lasers to switches, runs a fixed or after-the-fact policy. Lasers sharing an enclosure, cooling, and power can fail together. At a fixed spare ratio, correlated failure provably caps a pool's availability however large it grows. In this paper, we present a comprehensive predictive control plane framework, called Halley, that reads each resource's next state and acts before the failure occurs. It has four components, each carrying a formal guarantee: LightReserve that sizes the laser pool to provide a coverage bound, FoldFit that schedules the switch within 11/9 of the optimal, ThermaLead that holds a microring with one-step-ahead control, and TriageGuard that protects the highest-risk modules first. Halley gives each layer a predictive controller that defers to the deployed policy when unsure. Composed from simulations at that point, effective goodput, the share of ideal throughput kept, rises from 65.2\% to 76.5\% if a window that exhausts its spares is lost. If only the dark channels' bandwidth is lost, it reaches 67.4\%. Per megawatt, that is up to 1.03--1.17 times the training; for the same training, up to 3.3--14.7\% less data center capacity. Halley's fallback circuits are formally verified and are shown to achieve close timing on a commercial FPGA, and pass a 130~nm signoff.
items.description_zh: 前沿人工智能模型在人工智能数据中心、由专用网络连接的数万个加速器上进行训练，每个训练步骤都以所有加速器同时交换数据结束。在机架之间，该网络是光纤网络，从激光器到交换机，其四层中的每一层都运行固定或事后策略。共享外壳、冷却和电源的激光器可能会同时发生故障。在固定备用率下，无论池增长到多大，相关故障都可能限制池的可用性。在本文中，我们提出了一个名为 Halley 的综合预测控制平面框架，它读取每个资源的下一个状态并在故障发生之前采取行动。它有四个组件，每个组件都有正式的保证：LightReserve 调整激光池大小以提供覆盖范围，FoldFit 将切换安排在最佳值的 11/9 以内，ThermaLead 持有微环并进行一步控制，TriageGuard 首先保护最高风险的模块。 Halley 为每一层提供了一个预测控制器，在不确定时会遵循已部署的策略。从当时的模拟来看，如果耗尽备用资源的窗口丢失，有效吞吐量（保留的理想吞吐量的份额）将从 65.2% 上升到 76.5%。如果仅损失暗通道的带宽，则达到 67.4%。每兆瓦，即达到训练的1.03--1.17倍；对于相同的训练，数据中心容量最多可减少 3.3--14.7%。 Halley 的回退电路经过正式验证，并显示在商用 FPGA 上实现了接近的时序，并通过了 130nm 签核。

items.title: TaoMate-HD: Progressive-Resolution Autoregressive Audio-Video Generation
items.title_zh: TaoMate-HD：渐进分辨率自回归音频视频生成
items.description: Streaming digital humans produce detailed video while continuing speech as new text arrives. High-resolution denoising is costly, and text updates can cause repeated or interrupted speech. We present TaoMate-HD, an autoregressive model for high-resolution audio-video streaming. For each short segment, or chunk, two denoising steps establish coarse video structure at low resolution. A final step refines the video to high resolution, with audio generated throughout the same trajectory. Each stage passes its audiovisual predictions to the same stage of the next chunk as history. Across text updates, the model retains this history to infer what has already been spoken. Continuation training utilizes asymmetric text conditioning, with separate text windows for generation and distillation. Experiments show a 1.6x speedup over direct high-resolution generation with the same model and hardware. Optimized stage-parallel deployment provides a further 1.9x overall speedup over serial progressive generation. Our continuation training reduces character error rate by 11.18 percentage points relative to the baseline. The model also supports hour-long audiovisual generation. Our project page is https://taoliveaigc.github.io/TaoMate-HD.
items.description_zh: 流式数字人类会生成详细的视频，同时在新文本到达时继续进行语音。高分辨率去噪成本高昂，并且文本更新可能导致语音重复或中断。我们提出了TaoMate-HD，一种用于高分辨率音频视频流的自回归模型。对于每个短片段或块，两个降噪步骤以低分辨率建立粗略的视频结构。最后一步将视频优化为高分辨率，并在同一轨迹上生成音频。每个阶段将其视听预测作为历史传递到下一个块的同一阶段。在文本更新过程中，模型会保留此历史记录来推断已经说过的内容。继续训练利用不对称文本调节，具有用于生成和蒸馏的单独文本窗口。实验表明，使用相同的模型和硬件，比直接高分辨率生成速度提高了 1.6 倍。优化的级并行部署比串行渐进生成进一步提供 1.9 倍的整体加速。相对于基线，我们的继续训练将字符错误率降低了 11.18 个百分点。该模型还支持长达一小时的视听生成。我们的项目页面是https://taoliveaigc.github.io/TaoMate-HD。
items.authors: Qijun Gan, Chenwei Zhang, Xinyang Li, Meiguang Jin, Junfeng Ma, Shen Qiu

items.title: The SIMPLE Law for Energy Cost of LLM Inference
items.title_zh: LLM 推理能源成本的简单法则
items.description: Generative AI is billed per token, yet tokens are not equally expensive. Each token enters the KV-cache and raises the cost of those that follow, so energy grows non-linearly along a sequence whose tokens look identical. No analytical model states what a token costs, and the most accurate SOTA model is a fit, not a law: it absorbs architecture into fitted coefficients, requiring per-LLM fitting. We derive closed-form expressions of the computational and memory-access complexity of LLM inference in terms of architectural hyperparameters, covering MHA and GQA, and compare a family of analytical models of increasing granularity. From these, we obtain the SIMPLE Inference Model to Predict LLMs Energy (SIMPLE), a four-parameter law that separates prefill from decode, and decode into KV-cache cost and next-token computation. Over traces of 13 dense LLMs from six families on NVIDIA H100 GPUs, it attains R2 = 0.969 and 11.97% MAPE, 3.1-3.5x below the SOTA, without per-LLM calibration. The SIMPLE law explains as well as predicts: prefill energy grows quadratically with the hidden dimension, so larger LLMs suffer most from long inputs; and more aggressive GQA KV grouping reduces the per-token energy by up to 3x relative to standard MHA. Increasing the reasoning token budget pushes output length beyond the analytically derived energy minimum, driving super-linear energy growth; although accuracy grows with the budget, energy grows faster, so Intelligence per Joule peaks at an intermediate budget and falls by up to 3.14x across a 4.0x reasoning-budget range. Agentic serving raises energy per request by 13.0x relative to non-agentic ones, driven by the growth of both the prefill and the KV-cache terms with input length; while prefix caching removes most of the prefill cost (-93%), the KV-cache term is unaffected, so even a cached agentic request costs 4.8x more.
items.description_zh: 生成式人工智能按代币计费，但代币并不同样昂贵。每个令牌进入 KV 缓存并提高后续令牌的成本，因此能量沿着令牌看起来相同的序列非线性增长。没有分析模型说明代币的成本，最准确的 SOTA 模型是一个拟合，而不是一个定律：它将架构吸收到拟合系数中，需要每个 LLM 拟合。我们根据架构超参数推导了 LLM 推理的计算和内存访问复杂性的封闭式表达式，涵盖 MHA 和 GQA，并比较了一系列粒度递增的分析模型。���此，我们获得了预测 LLM 能量的简单推理模型 (SIMPLE)，这是一个四参数定律，将预填充与解码分开，并解码为 KV 缓存成本和下一个令牌计算。在 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上对来自 6 个系列的 13 个密集 LLM 进行跟踪后，它获得了 R2 = 0.969 和 11.97% MAPE，比 SOTA 低 3.1-3.5 倍，无需进行每个 LLM 校准。 SIMPLE 定律解释并预测：预填充能量随隐藏维度呈二次方增长，因此较大的 LLM 受到长输入的影响最大；与标准 MHA 相比，更积极的 GQA KV 分组可将每个代币的能量降低多达 3 倍。增加推理代币预算使输出长度超出分析得出的能量最小值，推动超线性能量增长；虽然准确性随着预算的增加而增加，但能量的增长速度更快，因此每焦耳智能在中间预算时达到峰值，并在 4.0 倍推理预算范围内下降最多 3.14 倍。由于预填充和 KV 缓存项随输入长度的增长，代理服务相对于非代理服务将每个请求的能量提高了 13.0 倍；虽然前缀缓存消除了大部分预填充成本 (-93%)，但 KV 缓存项不受影响，因此即使是缓存的代理请求，成本也会增加 4.8 倍。
items.authors: Hiari Pizzini Cavagna, Andrea Proia, Daniele Cesarini, Zeynep Kiziltan, Andrea Bartolini

items.title: HERIT: Enabling Global Access to Hanja-to-English Historical Translation by Mitigating Temporal Bias
items.title_zh: HERIT：通过减轻时间偏差实现汉字到英语历史翻译的全球访问
items.description: Historical archives are invaluable for multidisciplinary research but remain inaccessible globally due to severe language barriers. While manual translation is prohibitively expensive and time-consuming, simply applying existing machine translation models is inadequate due to unique linguistic nuances and the temporal bias inherent in scarce human-labeled corpora. To address these challenges, we propose HERIT, a systematic domain-adaptation pipeline that leverages retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to generate high-quality pseudo-labeled data from abundant Hanja-Korean corpora. This approach substantially expands the training dataset, mitigating both data scarcity and temporal overfitting across different historical periods. Extensive automated and human evaluations demonstrate that HERIT consistently outperforms baselines. Finally, we translate previously untranslated portions of the archives using our model, thereby enabling global access to these resources for researchers.
items.description_zh: 历史档案对于多学科研究来说非常宝贵，但由于严重的语言障碍，在全球范围内仍然无法访问。虽然手动翻译非常昂贵且耗时，但由于独特的语言细微差别和稀缺的人工标记语料库固有的时间偏差，仅仅应用现有的机器翻译模型是不够的。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 HERIT，这是一种系统的领域适应管道，利用检索增强生成 (RAG) 从丰富的韩语韩语语料库中生成高质量的伪标记数据。这种方法大大扩展了训练数据集，缓解了不同历史时期的数据稀缺和时间过度拟合。广泛的自动化和人工评估表明 HERIT 始终优于基线。最后，我们使用我们的模型翻译以前未翻译的档案部分，从而使研究人员能够在全球范围内访问这些资源。

items.title: Monitor Accuracy Isn't the Answer: A Decision-Value Framework for Evaluating AI Agent Restart Monitors
items.title_zh: 监视器准确性不是答案：用于评估 AI 代理重启监视器的决策价值框架
items.description: Classification accuracy and true-positive and false-positive rates alone do not determine whether restarting an AI agent improves success. Using an exact alarm-to-action identity for an independent clean restart with zero monitoring overhead, we show analytically that a monitor with fixed 90% accuracy can swing from a five-percentage-point loss to a 35-point gain in success rate, depending solely on the replacement attempt's residual-budget success probability. We introduce two techniques for evaluating monitors and progress signals in decision terms. First, a decision-sufficiency criterion, a binary-action specialization of Blackwell's comparison of experiments, identifies which progress representations or context compressions preserve the information needed to choose optimally between the specified actions, independent of trace reconstruction fidelity. Second, a finite-sample, model-free decision audit uses simultaneous binomial intervals over existing agent traces, without additional model calls, to certify a preference for "restart" or "continue" under stated sampling assumptions, or return "abstain" when evidence is insufficient. In a study of 194 externally evaluated model executions on 19 selected SymPy issues from SWE-bench Verified, with a retrospective audit of 130 of these traces, we find a 2.29-point apparent restart gain traced to a single surviving failed attempt, a 42.29-point loss on a second model, no positive replication of the initial gain on prospective task cohorts, and zero of 103 live comparisons meeting the specified certification bar. These results motivate evaluating agent monitors through recovery opportunity, decision value, and statistical support, rather than classification performance alone.
items.description_zh: 仅靠分类准确性以及真阳性率和假阳性率并不能确定重新启动 AI 代理是否会提高成功率。使用精确的警报到操作标识进行零监控开销的独立干净重启，我们分析表明，具有固定 90% 准确度的监控器可以在成功率上从 5 个百分点的损失变为 35 个百分点的增益，这仅取决于替换尝试的剩余预算成功概率。我们介绍了两种在决策方面评估监视器和进度信号的技术。首先，决策充分性标准是 Blackwell 实验比较的二元动作专门化，它确定哪些进度表示或上下文压缩保留了在指定动作之间进行最佳选择所需的信息，而与迹线重建保真度无关。其次，有限样本、无模型决策审计在现有代理轨迹上使用同时二项式区间，无需额外的模型调用，以证明在规定的抽样假设下偏好“重新启动”或“继续”，或者在证据不足时返回“弃权”。在对来自 SWE-bench Verified 的 19 个选定 SymPy 问题的 194 个外部评估模型执行进行的研究中，对其中 130 个跟踪进行了回顾性审计，我们发现，由于单个幸存的失败尝试，明显的重新启动增益为 2.29 点，第二个模型的损失为 42.29 点，在预期任务组中没有正面复制初始增益，并且满足指定认证标准的 103 个实时比较中的零个。这些结果激励通过恢复机会、决策值和统计支持来评估代理监控器，而不仅仅是分类性能。

items.title: Ask, Don't Equip: Question-Driven Coding Agents for Deep Kernel Optimization
items.title_zh: 询问，不要装备：用于深度内核优化的问题驱动编码代理
items.description: LLM agents for GPU kernel optimization sit at two ends of a structure-freedom tradeoff. Scripted agents fix what the model does at each step, via a learned policy, an optimization menu, or fixed roles, and are sample-efficient where the recipe applies and stall where it does not. Open-ended agents let a self-directed model mutate a population of kernels and pay for the freedom in trials: thousands of evaluations, repeated edits, and wrong candidates. Both respond to hard targets by equipping the agent with more: parsed profiler output, disassembly analysis, retrieval over documentation and libraries, and stores of lessons. We argue that both lack direction, a hypothesis about where the remaining gap is, and that a short question asked at the right moment supplies it without narrowing what the agent may do next. We present KernelSeek, a question-driven agent that makes an existing CUDA kernel faster with no operator-specific knowledge and no faster implementation to imitate: a general-purpose coding agent, a minimal harness that enforces a verifiable goal, and questions at decision points, first from a human, then from a bank the agent applies to itself. On the same task, evaluator, hardware, and week, a tool-rich autonomous agent built in the prevailing style plateaued at 0.50x FlashAttention-3 after 133 model-driven steps; KernelSeek reached 1.13x. It then produced dependency-free FlashAttention forward kernels for Hopper and Blackwell, single CUDA files with no CUTLASS, CuTe, cuBLAS, or cuDNN, correct on all 182 scenarios per architecture and 1.16x FlashAttention-3 and 1.46x FlashAttention-4 (geometric mean). Across 162 human messages and 11.5K agent tool calls, every large gain followed a question that moved the agent to a different layer of the system or rejected a claimed limit, never one that supplied information. We release the kernels, harness, question bank, and all traces.
items.description_zh: 用于 GPU 内核优化的 LLM 代理位于结构自由权衡的两端。脚本化代理通过学习策略、优化菜单或固定角色来修复模型在每个步骤中执行的操作，并且在适用配方的地方具有样本效率，在不适用配方的地方则停滞不前。开放式智能体让自我导向的模型改变一群内核，并为试验中的自由付出代价：数千次评估、重复编辑和错误的候选者。两者都通过为代理配备更多功能来响应硬目标：解析分析器输出、反汇编分析、文档和库检索以及课程存储。我们认为两者都缺乏方向，即对剩余差距在哪里的假设，并且在正确的时刻提出一个简短的问题可以提供方向，而不会缩小智能体下一步可能做什么。我们提出了 KernelSeek，一个问题驱动的代理，它使现有的 CUDA 内核更快，无需特定于操作员的知识，也无需模仿更快的实现：通用编码代理，强制执行可验证目标的最小工具，以及决策点的问题，首先来自人类，然后来自代理应用于自身的银行。在相同的任务、评估器、硬件和周内，以流行风格构建的工具丰富的自主代理在 133 个模型驱动步骤后稳定在 0.50x FlashAttention-3； KernelSeek 达到 1.13 倍。然后，它为 Hopper 和 Blackwell 生成了无依赖性的 FlashAttention 前向内核、没有 CUTLASS、CuTe、cuBLAS 或 cuDNN 的单个 CUDA 文件，在每个架构的所有 182 个场景上都正确，并且是 1.16 倍的 FlashAttention-3 和 1.46 倍的 FlashAttention-4（几何平均值）。在 162 条人工消息和 11,500 次代理工具调用中，每一次重大收获都伴随着一个问题，该问题将代理移至系统的不同层或拒绝声称的限制，但从未提供信息。我们发布了内核、工具、问题库和所有痕迹。
items.authors: Gabriele Oliaro, Jaeseong Lee, Zhaoyuan Su, Sreeram Vennam, Zhihao Jia, Samyam Rajbhandari

items.title: Why Pay for Long Reasoning When Rewrite Do Trick? Causal Effects of Reasoning History Compaction on Future Generation and Agent Cost
items.title_zh: 为什么重写时要付出长推理的代价？推理历史压缩对未来生成和代理成本的因果影响
items.description: Reasoning substantially improves language models' ability to solve difficult problems, but long reasoning traces make these gains expensive. Efficient reasoning should express useful analysis in fewer tokens by reducing repetition and text that adds little value to solving the problem. Progress in proprietary models motivates this goal, yet their hidden scratchpads limit direct study of how it is achieved. We investigate whether open-weight models can generate less verbose reasoning by changing the form of their own earlier thoughts, without retraining. Our intervention rewrites prior reasoning into compact state records before pending tool results are revealed, then compares continuations from original and compact histories. Across the tested models, accepted compact histories usually shorten future reasoning; a coding case study also shows less repeated verification after a shared candidate solution. In software-agent deployments, compaction can reduce total spending, although task quality and rewrite-inclusive time depend on the target and compressor. These findings identify reasoning history as one way to reduce future reasoning-token use and motivate model-specific compaction policies evaluated for both efficiency and retained capability.
items.description_zh: 推理极大地提高了语言模型解决难题的能力，但长推理轨迹使这些收益变得昂贵。有效的推理应该通过减少重复和对解决问题没有多大价值的文本，以更少的标记表达有用的分析。专有模型的进步推动了这一目标，但其隐藏的暂存器限制了对其实现方式的直接研究。我们研究开放权重模型是否可以通过改变其早期思想的形式来生成不那么冗长的推理，而无需重新训练。在显示待处理的工具结果之前，我们的干预将先前的推理重写为紧凑的状态记录，然后比较原始历史和紧凑历史的延续。在测试的模型中，公认的紧凑历史通常会缩短未来的推理；编码案例研究还表明，在共享候选解决方案后，重复验证会减少。在软件代理部署中，压缩可以减少总支出，尽管任务质量和重写时间取决于目标和压缩器。这些发现将推理历史确定为减少未来推理令牌使用并激励针对效率和保留能力进行评估的特定于模型的压缩策略的一种方法。

items.title: DRAP: Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity for Continual Learning in Physical AI
items.title_zh: DRAP：物理人工智能持续学习的动态风险自适应可塑性
items.description: Continual learning in physical AI differs from conventional continual learning because small per-step policy errors can accumulate over a trajectory. Each deviation may move the agent outside the training distribution, increase subsequent prediction errors, and ultimately cause closed-loop task failure. This work introduces Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity (DRAP), a replay-free method that estimates the historical importance of adaptable model tensors from sample-level action gradients weighted by local trajectory-amplification risk. A ridge-regularized local linear model is fitted to expert state-action transitions, and the largest singular value of its state-transition matrix provides a policy-independent, Lyapunov-inspired estimate of one-step perturbation amplification. After each task, risk-weighted squared gradients are accumulated in a tensor-level importance memory. During subsequent tasks, DRAP uses normalized cumulative importance to scale the effective AdamW learning rate of each tensor, immediately reducing the plasticity of components that supported previous behavior at dynamically sensitive trajectory points. We instantiate DRAP on a fixed KappaTune-selected subnetwork of OpenVLA and evaluate replay-free sequential adaptation across the LIBERO Spatial, Object, and Goal suites. Compared with standard AdamW fine-tuning and EWC, the results show substantially improved retention of previously learned behaviors while preserving strong new-suite acquisition.
items.description_zh: 物理人工智能中的持续学习与传统的持续学习不同，因为每步的小策略错误可能会在轨迹上累积。每个偏差都可能使智能体脱离训练分布，增加后续的预测误差，最终导致闭环任务失败。这项工作引入了动态风险自适应可塑性（DRAP），这是一种免重放的方法，可以根据局部轨迹放大风险加权的样本级动作梯度来估计自适应模型张量的历史重要性。岭正则化局部线性模型适合专家状态-动作转换，其状态转换矩阵的最大奇异值提供了一种与策略无关、受李雅普诺夫启发的单步扰动放大估计。每个任务完成后，风险加权平方梯度都会累积在张量级重要性存储器中。在后续任务中，DRAP 使用归一化累积重要性来缩放每个张量的有效 AdamW 学习率，立即降低在动态敏感轨迹点支持先前行为的组件的可塑性。我们在 OpenVLA 的固定 KappaTune 选择的子网络上实例化 DRAP，并评估 LIBERO 空间、对象和目标套件中的无重放顺序适应。与标准 AdamW 微调和 EWC 相比，结果显示，对先前学到���行为的保留率得到了显着提高，同时保持了强大的新套件获取能力。

items.title: LiveFoley: Dynamic Real-Time Video-to-Audio Generation for Immersive Interactive Worlds
items.title_zh: LiveFoley：用于沉浸式交互世界的动态实时视频音频生成
items.description: Streaming video-to-audio (V2A) generation is essential for immersive interactive applications. However, real-time constraints leave existing streaming V2A methods far behind offline models: (1) visual frontends shrink their receptive fields to cut look-ahead latency, severely degrading audio-visual alignment; (2) causal autoregressive diffusion backends denoise each audio patch in isolation, impairing audio quality. To this end, we present LiveFoley, a streaming causal autoregressive diffusion architecture that addresses both bottlenecks with imperceptible latency. For the visual frontend, we introduce a Trailing Sliding Window that converts non-causal segment-level encoders into streaming modules without retraining. By simply realigning the window, it preserves precise audio-visual alignment, while a configurable hop size reduces the frontend look-ahead well below the human perceptual threshold. Building on this tunable hop size, we propose the Unified Varhop Framework to accommodate scenarios with diverse latency and computation budgets. For the audio backend, we explore widening the denoising window of the local diffusion transformer (LocDiT) head in two temporal directions. History LocDiT adds past context to improve quality at no latency cost and serves as our default. Alternatively, Future-Warmup LocDiT breaks the autoregressive deadlock with an approximate future condition, further improving generation quality at the cost of an acceptable backend look-ahead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiveFoley matches offline models in temporal alignment and leads streaming systems in generation quality. Project page: https://dalision.github.io/livefoley-page/
items.description_zh: 流式视频转音频 (V2A) 生成对于沉浸式交互应用至关重要。然而，实时限制使现有的流式 V2A 方法远远落后于离线模型：（1）视觉前端缩小其感受野以减少前视延迟，严重降低了视听对齐； (2) 因果自回归扩散后端对每个音频补丁进行隔离降噪，从而损害音频质量。为此，我们提出了 LiveFoley，一种流式因果自回归扩散架构，它以难以察觉的延迟解决了这两个瓶颈。对于视觉前端，我们引入了一个尾随滑动窗口，它将非因果段级编码器转换为流模块，而无需重新训练。通过简单地重新对齐窗口，它可以保持精确的视听对齐，同时可配置的跳跃大小将前端前视降低到远低于人类感知阈值。在此可调跳大小的基础上，我们提出了统一 Varhop 框架，以适应具有不同延迟和计算预算的场景。对于音频后端，我们探索在两个时间方向上扩大局部扩散变压器（LocDiT）头的去噪窗口。历史 LocDiT 添加过去的上下文以提高质量，且无延迟成本，并且作为我们的默认设置。或者，Future-Warmup LocDiT 通过近似的未来条件打破自回归僵局，以可接受的后端前瞻为代价进一步提高发电质量。大量实验表明，LiveFoley 在时间对齐方面与离线模型相匹配，并在生成质量方面领先于流媒体系统。项目页面：https://dalision.github.io/livefoley-page/
items.authors: Yusheng Dai, Vladimir Iashin, Kangdi Wang, Yuxuan Jiang, Ilpo Viertola, Weiqiang Wang, Qiuhong Ke, Min Zhao, Jianfei Cai

items.title: UniRestorer++: Scalable Universal Image Restoration with Multi-Granularity Degradation Modeling
items.title_zh: UniRestorer++：具有多粒度退化建模的可扩展通用图像恢复
items.description: Universal image restoration aims to handle diverse degradations within a single model, but a reliable scaling strategy remains underexplored. Increasing backbone depth and width can lead to performance saturation, while degradation-aware specialization depends on accurate degradation estimation and is vulnerable to errors on out-of-distribution and real-world inputs. We propose UniRestorer++, a scalable framework based on multi-granularity degradation modeling. It progressively refines degradation groups and introduces group-specific experts, coupling capacity growth with specialization. Degradation-estimation-based routing selects a root-to-leaf path, while granularity-estimation-based routing chooses a level along that path to balance specialization and robustness. Spatially dense degradation representation maps further enable region-aware routing for spatially non-uniform corruptions. We develop CDD-50, a benchmark covering 50 degradation categories from single to penta-degradation. Experiments show approximately log-linear PSNR trends over the evaluated model-size range and stronger scaling gains on out-of-distribution and real-world data than vanilla MoE scaling. UniRestorer++ achieves state-of-the-art performance across benchmarks and demonstrates zero-shot generalization and few-shot transfer on real-world images. Code: https://github.com/mrluin/UniRestorer_plusplus
items.description_zh: 通用图像恢复旨在处理单个模型内的各种退化，但可靠的缩放策略仍未得到充分探索。增加主干深度和宽度可能会导致性能饱和，而降级感知专业化取决于准确的降级估计，并且容易受到分布外和现实世界输入的错误影响。我们提出了 UniRestorer++，一个基于多粒度退化建模的可扩展框架。它逐步细化降解小组并引入特定小组的专家，将能力增长与专业化结合起来。基于降级估计的路由选择根到叶路径，而基于粒度估计的路由选择沿该路径的��别以平衡专业化和鲁棒性。空间密集的退化表示图进一步实现了空间非均匀损坏的区域感知路由。我们开发了 CDD-50，这是一个涵盖从单次降解到五次降解的 50 个降解类别的基准。实验表明，在评估的模型大小范围内，PSNR 呈近似对数线性趋势，并且与普通 MoE 缩放相比，分布外数据和真实世界数据的缩放增益更强。 UniRestorer++ 在基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，并在现实世界图像上演示了零样本泛化和少样本传输。代码：https://github.com/mrluin/UniRestorer_plusplus
items.authors: Jingbo Lin, Zhilu Zhang, Fan Li, Renjing Pei, Wenbo Li, Hang Xu, Hongzhi Zhang, Wangmeng Zuo

items.title: GaussianRenderFormer: Transformer-based Rendering of 3D Gaussian Splats
items.title_zh: GaussianRenderFormer：基于 Transformer 的 3D 高斯 Splats 渲染
items.description: Can a neural network learn to render 3D Gaussian splats on its own, with no rasterizer in the renderer? We present GaussianRenderFormer, a transformer that takes a set of Gaussians and a camera and outputs the image directly. Each Gaussian becomes one token in a view-independent encoder, and a view-dependent decoder turns small patches of camera rays into pixels by attending to those tokens. Trained on 26,820 Objaverse objects pruned to 20,000 Gaussians each, GaussianRenderFormer renders 300 unseen objects at 38.08 dB PSNR against the full, unpruned splats, while rasterizing the same pruned input reaches 44.02 dB. The gap is not one of generalization, and our diagnostics are consistent with a bottleneck in the view decoder: telling it the projected footprint of each Gaussian, which it could in principle infer, adds 1.4 dB. Under-training is not ruled out. Code, trained models and videos: https://svlwoof.github.io/gaussianrenderformer
items.description_zh: 神经网络能否学会在渲染器中没有光栅器的情况下自行渲染 3D 高斯图？我们提出了 GaussianRenderFormer，一个转换器，它采用一组高斯函数和一个相机并直接输出图像。每个高斯成为与视图无关的编码器中的一个标记，并且与视图相关的解码器通过关注这些标记将小块相机光线转换为像素。 GaussianRenderFormer 在 26,820 个 Objaverse 对象（每个对象修剪为 20,000 高斯）上进行训练，针对完整的未修剪的图块以 38.08 dB PSNR 渲染 300 个看不见的对象，而光栅化相同的修剪输入达到 44.02 dB。这一差距不是泛化性的，我们的诊断与视图解码器中的瓶颈一致：告诉它每个高斯的预计足迹，它原则上可以推断出增加了 1.4 dB。不排除训练不足的情况。代码、训练模型和视频：https://svlwoof.github.io/gaussianrenderformer

items.title: TAC-CoT: Tool-Empowered Implicit Chain-of-Thought via Interleaving Explicit Tokens
items.title_zh: TAC-CoT：通过交错显式令牌实现工具授权的隐式思维链
items.description: LLM-based agentic systems are increasingly combined with CoT reasoning to solve tasks that require accurate reasoning, external knowledge, and multi-step deliberation. Yet, explicit CoT incurs substantial generation overhead, while implicit CoT, which replaces textual rationales with compact continuous tokens, does not naturally support the explicit communication interface required for agentic tool-use. We propose TAC-CoT, a tool-empowered adaptive implicit CoT framework that replaces explicit reasoning traces with compact latent reasoning segments while retaining textual tokens only for tool calls, observations, and final answers. This interleaved design enables agentic tool-use without verbalizing every intermediate reasoning step. Experiments on agentic math and QA benchmarks show that TAC-CoT improves accuracy by up to 8.8 points while reducing model forward passes by up to 6.8x. Furthermore, analyses show that TAC-CoT improves tool-use quality in both single- and multi-tool settings.
items.description_zh: 基于 LLM 的代理系统越来越多地与 CoT 推理相结合，以解决需要准确推理、外部知识和多步骤审议的任务。然而，显式 CoT 会产生大量的生成开销，而隐式 CoT（用紧凑的连续标记取代文本原理）自然不支持代理工具使用所需的显式通信接口。我们提出了 TAC-CoT，一种工具赋能的自适应隐式 CoT 框架，它用紧凑的潜在推理片段取代显式推理轨迹，同时仅保留工具调用、观察和最终答案的文本标记。这种交错设计可以实现代理工具的使用，而无需用语言描述每个中间推理步骤。代理数学和 QA 基准测试表明，TAC-CoT 将准确性提高了 8.8 分，同时将模型前向传递次数减少了 6.8 倍。此外，分析表明，TAC-CoT 提高了单工具和多工具设置中的工具使用质量。
items.authors: Juseon Do, Sangmin Bae, Jeesu Jung, Hwanjun Song

items.title: NitroFusion2: Bringing Adversarial Loss to the Text Stream of Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
items.title_zh: NitroFusion2：为多模态扩散变压器的文本流带来对抗性损失
items.description: Adversarial diffusion distillation has conventionally relied on image features for discrimination. We revisit this choice for multimodal diffusion transformers (MMDiTs), whose text stream becomes image-dependent through joint attention. We introduce Text-Stream Adversarial Distillation (TSAD), which exploits intermediate text-token states as a new adversarial representation. Because the text stream has already read the image while remaining tied to the text condition, changing that condition changes what information it extracts from the image. Building on this property, we introduce Aspect-Cued Discrimination (ACD), which conditions the discriminator on different aspects of the sample, such as typography, objects, or style, to steer which properties are emphasized during adversarial training. Building on the expert-discriminator design of NitroFusion, we integrate TSAD and ACD in NitroFusion2. NitroFusion2 brings few-step distillation from the conventional 4-8-step regime down to just 1-2 steps at comparable quality. At one step, it produces sharp rendered text and rich fine-grained details, making one-step generation practical rather than merely a stress test for distillation. At two steps, it remains competitive across the evaluated benchmarks. These results establish the MMDiT text stream as a powerful and steerable representation for adversarial diffusion distillation.
items.description_zh: 对抗性扩散蒸馏传统上依赖图像特征进行区分。我们重新审视多模态扩散变换器（MMDiT）的这种选择，其文本流通过联合注意力变得依赖于图像。我们引入了文本流对抗蒸馏（TSAD），它利用中间文本令牌状态作为新的对抗性表示。由于文本流已经读取了图像，同时仍与文本条件相关，因此更改该条件会更改它从图像中提取的信息。在此属性的基础上，我们引入了方面提示判别（ACD），它根据样本的不同方面（例如版式、对象或风格）来限制判别器，以引导在对抗性训练期间���调哪些属性。基于 NitroFusion 的专家鉴别器设计，我们将 TSAD 和 ACD 集成到 NitroFusion2 中。 NitroFusion2 将数步蒸馏从传统的 4-8 步方案减少到仅需 1-2 步，且质量相当。第一步，它会生成清晰的渲染文本和丰富的细粒度细节，使一步生成变得实用，而不仅仅是蒸馏的压力测试。通过两个步骤，它在评估的基准中保持竞争力。这些结果将 MMDiT 文本流确立为对抗性扩散蒸馏的强大且可操纵的表示形式。

items.title: Hybrid Computer Use: A Unified Programmatic, Semantic, and Visual Interface for General Agents
items.title_zh: 混合计算机使用：通用代理的统一编程、语义和可视化界面
items.description: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle tasks ranging from everyday desktop activities to long-horizon professional workflows. Yet interfaces centered on screenshots and mouse-and-keyboard actions can impose a human-interaction prior, requiring repeated screen interpretation while leaving the computer's semantic and programmatic capabilities underexposed. We argue for exposing these capabilities and letting models choose and combine them. We introduce Hybrid Computer Use (HCU), a unified interface for general agents that combines three complementary channels: programmatic interaction through code and command-line tools, semantic interaction through accessibility (AX), and visual interaction through graphical user interfaces (GUI). Our HCU supports efficient AX interaction and guards against stale-state actions during channel switching. A supplementary HCU skill guides agents in selecting and coordinating channels to use the unified interface effectively. Our designed AX tools return compact observations, execute actions in batches, and report their effects as AX diffs, so the model needs fewer round trips. On OSWorld 2.0, HCU achieves the highest Partial and Binary scores among the compared systems. Analyzing agent trajectories, we find that all evaluated models improve with HCU yet allocate work across the channels differently and consistently outperform compared baselines in terms of both efficiency and task success, highlighting the value of unified computer-use interfaces that allow flexible channel selection and combination.
items.description_zh: 使用计算机的代理越来越多地处理从日常桌面活动到长期专业工作流程的任务。然而，以屏幕截图和鼠标键盘操作为中心的界面可能会优先考虑人机交互，需要重复的屏幕解释，同时使计算机的语义和编程能力暴露不足。我们主张公开这些功能并让模型选择和组合它们。我们引入了混合计算机使用（HCU），这是一个通用代理的统一界面，它结合了三个互补渠道：通过代码和命令行工具的编程交互、通过可访问性（AX）的语义交互以及通过图形用户界面（GUI）的视觉交互。我们的 HCU 支持高效的 AX 交互并防止通道切换期间的陈旧状态操作。补充 HCU 技能可指导座席选择和协调渠道，以有效地使用统一界面。我们设计的 AX 工具返回紧凑的观察结果，批量执行操作，并将其效果报告为 AX 差异，因此模型需要更少的往返。在 OSWorld 2.0 上，HCU 在比较系统中获得了最高的部分和二进制分数。通过分析代理轨迹，我们发现所有评估的模型都通过 HCU 进行了改进，但在不同渠��之间分配工作的方式不同，并且在效率和任务成功方面始终优于比较基准，这凸显了允许灵活渠道选择和组合的统一计算机使用界面的价值。
items.authors: Haoqing Wang, Xiaoyi Zhang, Sicheng Fan, Zhexin Zhang, Xinjie Zhang, Jiahao Li, Bin Li, Yan Lu
